description.value: Combines the ability to execute vendor payments with control over posting periods.

F019.controls: Independent review of payment runs; restricted period-opening authority; review of period changes and payment logs.
F019.guidance: Confirm whether the user genuinely requires both AP01 and FI06. Verify that payment execution and period control cannot reasonably be separated.
F019.impact: A user may process payments while also influencing when related transactions can be posted, increasing the risk of unauthorized transactions being concealed or shifted between periods.

name.value: Production Confirmation vs. Production Order Management

M002.controls: Independent review of production confirmations; variance monitoring; separate approval or release responsibility where feasible.
M002.description: Combines confirmation of production with creation, modification or release of production orders.
M002.guidance: Confirm whether the user must both manage production orders and confirm their execution. Check whether operational responsibilities justify PP01 + PP02.
M002.impact: A user may control both the production instruction and its reported execution, reducing independent verification of production quantities and activities.
